BiblicalUsage: Harim = "dedicated"; 1) a priest in the time of David who had charge of the 3rd course; 2) head of a family of exiles totalling 1017 who returned with Zerubbabel; 3) another head of a family of exiles totalling 320 who returned with Zerubbabel; 4) a priest in the time of Nehemiah; 5) a ruler of the people under Nehemiah
